classes.description: ElectronicProcedure — 电子程序（版本化实体）。分配给规范(Spec)执行的结构化操作引导程序。通过 EProcedureDetail 连接实体按顺序关联多个任务列表(TaskList)，每个任务列表包含多个任务(TaskItem)。任务类型包括 Instruction(操作指导)、MaterialIssue(物料发行)、DataCollection(数据采集)、Computation(计算)等。

classes.description: EProcedureDetail — 电子程序明细（ElectronicProcedure 的子实体）。连接 ElectronicProcedure 与 TaskList，并定义该任务列表在电子程序中的执行顺序(sequence)。一个 TaskList 可被多个 EP 以不同顺序引用。

properties.name: electronicProcedure
properties.description: 关联的母电子程序流程 → ElectronicProcedure

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读）

properties.name: sequence
properties.description: 任务列表在电子程序中的执行顺序号（必填）

properties.description: 关联的任务列表基准版本 → TaskListBase

properties.name: taskList
properties.description: 引用的任务列表(TaskList)（必填）

classes.description: TaskList — 任务列表（版本化实体）。操作员在特定工序必须执行的任务集合，支持 Sequential(顺序执行) 和 AnyOrder(任意顺序) 两种执行模式。可指定前置任务列表(PrerequisiteTaskList)、工位(Workstation/WorkstationGroup)，以及通用指导说明(Instruction/ReportInstruction)。 【Swagger】Schema: TaskListEntity；来源文件: TaskLists.json；API: /api/TaskLists。

properties.name: taskListBase
properties.description: 关联的任务列表基准版本 → TaskListBase

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 安全配置访问控制 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: prerequisiteTaskList
properties.description: 前置任务列表（自引用FK：PrerequisiteTaskListId → TaskList） 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr
properties.description: 关联的WIP消息定义管理器 【Swagger】引用 Schema: WIPMsgEntity。

properties.name: instruction
properties.description: 通用操作指导说明文本（最长4000字符） 【Swagger】Instructions for the user on how to execute the Tasks in the TaskList.

properties.name: executionMode
properties.description: 执行模式：0=Sequential(顺序), 1=AnyOrder(任意) 【Swagger】Identifies whether the Tasks are to be performed in sequence. 1 = Sequential 2 = Non-Sequential

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注说明 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联的图标标识 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: revision
properties.description: 修订版本号 【Swagger】Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

properties.name: status
properties.description: 状态：1=Active, 2=Inactive 【Swagger】Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

properties.name: workstation
properties.description: 指定工位资源(WorkstationId → ResourceDef) 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: eco
properties.description: 工程变更单号(ECO) 【Swagger】Engineering Change Order

properties.name: workstationGroup
properties.description: 指定工位资源组(WorkstationGroupId → ResourceGroup) 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: reportInstruction
properties.description: 报表专用指导说明文本（最长4000字符） 【Swagger】Instructions for the user on how to execute the Tasks in the TaskList without any display format applied. Used primarly for reporting purposes where markup and tags are not supported.

properties.name: isImage
properties.description: 关联的图示指示文档 → isImage 【Swagger】引用 Schema: RevisionedObjectRef。

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list

properties.name: variantExpression
properties.description: 物理字段 VariantExpression 【Swagger】Variant expression to be resolved to allow for filtering out configurable activities.

classes.description: TaskItem — 任务项（TaskList 的子实体）。操作员必须执行的单一动作。根据 taskType 决定关联的目标实体：Instruction(显示富文本指导)、MaterialIssue(物料发行)、DataCollection(数据采集)、Computation(公式计算)等。支持循环执行(minIterations/maxIterations)、自动推进(advanceToNextTask)、电子签名(eSigRequirement)、培训要求(trainingReqGroup)、前置任务(PrerequisiteTasks)等。 【Swagger】Schema: TaskItemChanges；来源文件: MfgOrderTaskLists.json；API: /api/MfgOrderTaskLists。

properties.name: taskList
properties.description: 关联的母任务列表 → TaskList

properties.name: computation
properties.description: 关联的计算公式(Computation)

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: name
properties.description: 任务项名称 【Swagger】Unique name for the name subentity.

properties.name: taskType
properties.description: 任务类型编码：Instruction/MaterialIssue/DataCollection/Computation/Transaction/Checklist 【Swagger】Identifies whether this is a Start Process Task, an End Process Task, or a Regular Task. This identifies when the Container is assigned to the Workstation or WorkCell for line clearance purposes.

properties.name: eSigRequirement
properties.description: 电子签名要求 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: trainingReqGroup
properties.description: 培训要求组 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: sequence
properties.description: 任务在列表中的序号 【Swagger】Identifies the order in which the Task displayed and/or processed within the context of the other Tasks in its parent TaskList.

properties.name: minIterations
properties.description: 任务最小执行次数 【Swagger】The minimum number of times a task must be executed.

properties.name: maxIterations
properties.description: 任务最大执行次数 【Swagger】The maximum number of times that the Task may be executed.

properties.name: instruction
properties.description: 富文本操作指导说明（最长4000字符） 【Swagger】Instructions for the user on how to execute the Task.

properties.name: instructionType
properties.description: 指导说明格式类型编码 【Swagger】Enumeration for the InstructionType. 1 = Pass/Fail 2 = Data Collection 3 = Acknowledgement 4 = Computation

properties.name: reportInstruction
properties.description: 报表专用指导说明文本 【Swagger】Instructions for the user on how to execute the Task. Used primarly for reporting purposes where markup and tags are not supported.

properties.name: taskUsage

properties.name: advanceToNextTask
properties.description: 是否自动推进到下一任务 【Swagger】This field is used during the execution time to define whether the system should begin the next task automatically after the minimum number of iterations for the current task have been completed.
